entries.what: Brakes lab at Tamsen Valley 8-11, then lunch in the truck and a bit of chapter reading before heading home.
entries.outcome: Finished the brake job clean, bay swept before leaving.

entries.what: Filled up the Tacoma at the Ruel Road station, then helped Gladys and Oscar run through supplies for the stand.
entries.outcome: Supply list ready for the weekend.

entries.what: Pickup soccer at Delgado Park Monday evening with friends.
entries.outcome: Played hard, got home sweaty and hungry.

entries.what: Watched engine teardown videos in bed until midnight.
entries.outcome: Fell asleep with the phone at 20%.

entries.what: Quiet morning at home, then drove to Tamsen Valley for the afternoon.
entries.outcome: Got a decent parking spot in Lot C.

entries.what: Engine performance class 1-4 with Salas, working on a misfire diagnosis with Dante.
entries.outcome: Diagnosed the misfire by ear before the scope confirmed it.

entries.what: Dante mentioned the Tuesday salvage auction again while they cleaned the bay.
entries.outcome: Rafael listened but did not commit.

entries.what: Ate dinner with his parents and talked about moving the stand on Saturday.
entries.outcome: Agreed to haul the canopy and generator to the new lot.

entries.what: Brakes lab 8-11, then a stop at Ruiz Family Market with Gladys for stand groceries.
entries.outcome: Got pork shoulder at the family price.

entries.what: Serviced the stand's generator in the driveway before the move.
entries.outcome: It ran smooth after an oil check.

entries.what: Evening at home reading the G1 chapter and getting frustrated with the wording.
entries.outcome: Gave up around 10 and watched videos instead.

entries.what: Morning class prep, then engine performance 1-4 with Salas.
entries.outcome: Solid lab day.

entries.what: Asked the assistant to turn the chapter into short spoken flashcards he could record as voice memos.
entries.outcome: Recorded the first batch from the truck and dropped rereading the chapter the night before.

entries.what: Thursday stand shift at the Delgado lot, listening to flashcards while prepping the griddle.
entries.outcome: Remembered more terms than expected.

entries.what: Brakes lab and a quick lunch with Ximena on campus.
entries.outcome: She asked about the stand move and his plans beyond it.

entries.what: Friday evening at the stand packing up early to drive Dulce home from Colima at 9.
entries.outcome: Dulce got home safe by 9:30.

entries.what: Helped load the truck bed with the canopy poles for tomorrow.
entries.outcome: Everything staged by the garage door.

entries.what: Moved the canopy, generator and griddle to the Ruel Road gas station lot and set up for the first night, with Oscar and Gladys.
entries.outcome: Stand opened 5-10 p.m. in the new lot, replacing the Sunday market; Gladys kept watching the dark edges of the lot.

entries.what: Luz stayed at the Delgado market and stopped by to wish them luck on the move.
entries.outcome: Friendly send-off.

entries.what: Got home late and stayed up drafting a setup checklist for his parents instead of studying.
entries.outcome: Checklist printed for next week; no flashcards tonight.

entries.what: Slept in, then helped Gladys with masa and curtido at the house.
entries.outcome: Prep done by noon.

entries.what: Sunday evening shift at the Ruel Road lot, using the new checklist.
entries.outcome: Setup went faster than Saturday; Ximena helped with the line.

entries.what: Played voice-memo flashcards in the truck on the drive home.
entries.outcome: Got most right.
